_doc: DO-35 axial diodes (the 1N4148, a keyboard's matrix diode, through-hole), lying flat on the board with their leads bent down at 0.3 in. kind as in x1c.json.
name: do35

pitch.rule: Lead holes this far apart: the leads bent down at 0.3 in
pitch.source: KiCad footprint library, Diode_THT.pretty/D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (from Diodes Inc.'s DO-35 drawing, http://www.diodes.com/_files/packages/DO-35.pdf), https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

drill.source: KiCad footprint library, Diode_THT.pretty/D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (from Diodes Inc.'s DO-35 drawing, http://www.diodes.com/_files/packages/DO-35.pdf), https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

pad.rule: Round copper pad round each lead
pad.source: KiCad footprint library, Diode_THT.pretty/D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (from Diodes Inc.'s DO-35 drawing, http://www.diodes.com/_files/packages/DO-35.pdf), https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

body_length.source: KiCad footprint library, Diode_THT.pretty/D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (from Diodes Inc.'s DO-35 drawing, http://www.diodes.com/_files/packages/DO-35.pdf), https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

body_d.source: KiCad footprint library, Diode_THT.pretty/D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (from Diodes Inc.'s DO-35 drawing, http://www.diodes.com/_files/packages/DO-35.pdf), https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

lead_d.source: Vishay 1N4148 datasheet, DO-35 package drawing (0.45 to 0.55 mm leads), https://www.vishay.com/docs/81857/1n4148.pdf

lead_out.rule: Leads left below the board once trimmed
lead_out.source: Common practice: trim leads to about 1.5 mm after soldering
